title: Solo dev here - my Yahtzee roguelike deckbuilder is finally launching this November
author: BeyondAffinity
selftext:
I've been building Seferia Matrix alone - a dice roguelike deckbuilder where you Lock and Roll five dice to complete a hand, and the hand casts a spell. Artifacts, sigils and upgrades all stack into the scoring formula, so late runs turn into ridiculous score explosions.

With this project, I've built my own LLM-driven-pipeline, and they are pretty successful so far since Matrix is one of many upcoming game for me, and 90%+ ai-generated in every inch of the game.

Demo is up on Steam, launch is this November.
